headlines.title_en: Dalian launches interest subsidy for second-home provident fund loans; nearly 90 cities issue housing subsidies this year
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Dalian introduced a temporary subsidy policy for provident fund loans, offering up to three years of subsidies on second-home provident fund loans approved between July 24, 2026, and December 31, 2027, covering 15% of actual interest, to ease repayment pressure for homebuyers seeking upgrades. Nationwide, nearly 90 cities have rolled out various home purchase subsidies and loan relief measures this year, expanding local tools to stabilize the housing market, though Dalian’s fiscal interest subsidy for second-home provident fund loans is a relatively rare recent exploration. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 新策略实现超高稳定性钠离子电池
headlines.summary: 在国家自然科学基金等项目资助下，广东工业大学材料与能源学院副教授张伟、教授熊世云和教授黄少铭团队在钠离子电池负极材料领域取得重要进展。相关成果近日发表于《先进材料》（Advanced Materials）。该研究首次从路易斯酸碱催化角度揭示了多硒化物转化与穿梭的内在机制，提出了“电子结构调控-双位点自催化-晶格缓冲”协同设计新范式，为开发超长寿命金属硒化物负极材料提供了全新思路，对推动钠离子电池在大规模储能领域的实际应用具有重要意义。（中国科学报）

headlines.title_en: New strategy achieves ultra-high stability sodium-ion batteries
headlines.summary_en: With support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China and other projects, a team led by Associate Professor Zhang Wei, Professor Xiong Shiyun, and Professor Huang Shaoming from the School of Materials and Energy at Guangdong University of Technology has made significant progress in anode materials for sodium-ion batteries. The findings were recently published in *Advanced Materials*. This study reveals, for the first time from a Lewis acid-base catalysis perspective, the intrinsic mechanism of polyselenide conversion and shuttling, proposing a new synergistic design paradigm of 'electronic structure regulation - double-site self-catalysis - lattice buffering,' offering novel insights for developing ultra-long-life metal selenide anode materials, with important implications for advancing sodium-ion batteries in large-scale energy storage applications. (China Science Daily)

headlines.title_en: Private securities investment fund committee of AMAC says regulators are closely monitoring extreme situations
headlines.summary_en: The Private Securities Investment Fund Committee of the Asset Management Association of China stated that regulators closely monitor extreme situations. The Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing stock exchanges have set monitoring indicators for 'short-term large-volume transactions,' clarifying that actions triggering significant index fluctuations through rapid trading volumes constitute abnormal transactions. Once triggered, exchanges promptly apply self-regulatory measures to mitigate adverse effects of quantitative trading on market stability. (Yicai)

headlines.title_en: Yongshan Lithium: Application for A-share private placement accepted by Shanghai Stock Exchange
headlines.summary_en: [Yongshan Lithium: A-share private placement application accepted by SSE] On July 26, Yongshan Lithium announced that on July 24, 2026, it received notification from the Shanghai Stock Exchange that the application documents for issuing securities to specific targets on the main board were complete and met legal requirements, and the SSE decided to accept and review them. The private placement of A-shares remains subject to SSE approval and China Securities Regulatory Commission registration before implementation, with uncertainties regarding ultimate approval and timing.

headlines.title: 美高官欲访巴西遭拒签 被指“干涉选举”
headlines.summary: 据央视，巴西外交部25日证实，该国已正式拒绝两名美国国务院高级官员的赴巴签证申请。巴西方面怀疑美方官员此行意在干涉巴西定于10月举行的总统选举。被拒签的美方官员包括美国助理国务卿赖利·巴恩斯和助理国务卿帮办塞缪尔·萨姆森。巴西外交部说，这两人20日提交签证申请，24日被拒，但未提及拒签原因。

headlines.title_en: US senior official denied visa to visit Brazil, accused of interfering in elections
headlines.summary_en: According to CCTV, on the 25th, Brazil’s Foreign Ministry confirmed that the country has formally denied visa applications from two senior US State Department officials. Brazil suspects the US officials’ visit aimed to interfere in Brazil’s presidential election scheduled for October. The denied US officials include Assistant Secretary of State Reilly Barnes and Deputy Assistant Secretary of State Samuel Samson. Brazil’s Foreign Ministry said the two submitted visa applications on the 20th and were rejected on the 24th, without citing reasons.
